name: interpro-mcp-server
description: Search InterPro entries, map domains and functional sites onto UniProt proteins and PDB structures, find proteins by domain, and scan raw protein sequences via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

INTERPRO_SCAN_EMAIL.title: InterProScan contact email
INTERPRO_SCAN_EMAIL.description: Optional. Contact address the EBI Job Dispatcher requires to submit InterProScan jobs for sequences with no precalculated matches. Without it interpro_scan_sequence still returns precalculated matches and fails other sequences as scan_not_configured. EBI stores the address with job data for seven days.
